# Design tokens

Every colour, spacing, radius, shadow and font size comes from these `--sl-*` custom properties. Values are the light theme; the dark theme redefines the same names, so always reference the token and never copy the value. A token that is not in this list does not exist.

Check a name quickly with `node <skill>/scripts/ds.mjs tokens <text>`.

## Primitive colour palettes (avoid)

`--sl-color-{amber,blue,cyan,emerald,fuchsia,gray,green,indigo,lime,orange,pink,purple,red,rose,sky,teal,violet,yellow}-{50…950}` also exist, inherited from Shoelace. They carry no meaning and do not follow the Saipem palette: use the semantic tokens above (primary, accent, success, warning, danger, neutral) or the surface and border tokens.
